title: 學員匯入 — Stateless Mapping API 與原子寫入
content: 為 AF-021 實作檔案檢視、mapping preview 與 confirm API。使用 AF-019 raw-table parser，依 zero-based source index 驗證管理員 mapping；preview/confirm 每次重新上傳與重驗，無 importId/server preview store。確認只建立新 User，整批單一 transaction，任一錯誤完整 rollback。移除 temp-store/importId 流程並保留 ADMIN、10MB、檔案類型檢查。

comments.name: User
comments.text: Approved flexible source-header mapping direction; Variant C is the selected UI.

acceptance: Inspect request returns source indices/labels and at most 3 sample rows without persisting files, rows, mappings, or sessions
Mapped preview and confirm accept file plus source-index mapping; server validates source bounds, allowlisted targets, uniqueness, and required targets
Every request rechecks ADMIN, .csv/.xlsx, and 10MB constraints
Preview is read-only; row, mapping, and structural errors block confirmation
Confirm reparses/revalidates, rejects existing and intra-file duplicates, creates only new Users in one transaction, and rolls back all writes on failure
No importId or temp-store references remain after migration
Unit/API/database tests cover mapping edge cases, authorization, statelessness, and atomic rollback
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run build pass
files: src/lib/data/import/registrants.ts (update — apply source-index mapping and validate all rows)
src/lib/data/import/temp-store.ts (remove after all importId consumers are gone)
src/lib/data/import/registrants.test.mts (new/extend — mapping rules and API/service cases)
verification: Test raw inspection, mapping valid/invalid indices and targets, required/optional fields, duplicate source/target assignments, auth and upload limits, no-write preview, confirm revalidation, duplicate rejection, all-row commit, and forced transaction rollback against a dedicated local test database. Run npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run build, and focused Node tests.
